look_here_first: Start with life cycle and the upper sheaths. Poverty dropseed is an annual, usually much smaller than perennial dropseeds, and it produces cleistogamous flowers hidden in the upper leaf sheaths.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays long-term flora; Travis Balcones Canyonlands Preserve; Williamson County treatment.

best_field_traits: very narrow leaves about 1–2 mm wide
